screenshots.name: wh-dashboard-overview
screenshots.description: Warehouse Dashboard top section showing KPI stat cards, quick action buttons, and pending approvals grid
screenshots.desiredState: Dashboard fully loaded with KPI stat cards visible at top, quick action command cards below
screenshots.differentiator: Shows the top portion of the dashboard — KPI cards and quick actions, NOT the analytics/charts section

screenshots.name: wh-dashboard-alerts
screenshots.description: Critical alerts banner showing stock-out and expiry warnings with View Details link
screenshots.desiredState: Dashboard scrolled to show the critical alerts banner section
screenshots.differentiator: Focuses on the alerts/warnings banner — NOT KPI cards or analytics charts
screenshots.knownLimitation: Alerts section may be empty if no active warnings in mock data

captureSteps.script: var el = document.querySelector('[class*=alert], [class*=Alert], [class*=expiry]'); if(el) el.scrollIntoView({behavior:'instant', block:'start'})

screenshots.name: wh-dashboard-activity
screenshots.description: Notification feed showing recent warehouse events with unread indicators and activity timeline
screenshots.desiredState: Dashboard scrolled to show notifications/activity timeline section
screenshots.differentiator: Shows the activity feed and notifications — NOT KPI cards or analytics charts

screenshots.name: wh-dashboard-analytics
screenshots.description: Analytics section showing daily volume sparklines for receipts and transfers, and top 5 most moved items
screenshots.desiredState: Dashboard scrolled to bottom showing analytics charts and top moved items table
screenshots.differentiator: Shows analytics charts and top items — the BOTTOM of the dashboard

mustShow: Top items table or progress bars

notes: Dashboard loads data automatically — no search button needed. Scroll to different sections for each screenshot.
